Quick Answer for Sourcing

BestPackFactory has launched a new Technical RFQ (Request for Quote) system designed to help overseas buyers provide engineering-ready specifications. This new process reduces back-and-forth communication and delivers more accurate pricing within 12-24 hours.

Key Buyer Checklist

  • Verify MOQ and material specifications.
  • Confirm dieline and artwork requirements.
  • Request lead time for production and shipping.
  • Validate barrier properties (for flexible packaging).

Verification method and acceptance evidence

Method for New RFQ Guidance System Launched for Overseas Packaging Buyers: Record the approved sample revision, packed condition, lot size, inspection level, defect classes, acceptance limit, conditioning, equipment and pass/fail rule before inspection.

  • ISO 2859-1:2026 defines AQL-indexed sampling schemes and acceptance or rejection rules for lot-by-lot inspection.
  • ASTM D5276-19(2023) covers free-fall drop testing of loaded boxes, cylindrical containers, bags and sacks as packed systems.

Evidence limit: These standards define repeatable methods, not a passing result for a BestPackFactory order. Release decisions require a project-specific inspection or test report tied to the approved sample and production lot. Procurement FAQ — New RFQ Guidance System Launched for Overseas Packaging Buyers

What is the MOQ for New RFQ Guidance System Launched for Overseas Packaging Buyers?

Our standard minimum order quantity (MOQ) for custom projects is 500 PCS. We support small brands with factory-direct pricing.

Do you provide free dielines?

Yes! Once you provide dimensions, our engineering team sends a free dieline template within 24 hours.

How long is the production time?

Bulk production is usually completed within 20-30 days after final sample approval.

Do you support global shipping?

Yes, we ship worldwide from China via sea, air, and express courier (DHL/FedEx).

Can I get a sample first?

Yes. We offer digital proofing for free and physical pre-production samples for a small fee.
